reviews.summary: North's brand director Mike Raper and designer Pepijn Smith detail the Pulse as a ground-up Modern-C design centred on maximum line slack for unhooked freestyle. Key highlights include the fifth-line single bridle for safe relaunch, a five-strut canopy for stability, adjustable bar pressure, and a 3D arc leading edge that eliminates transition panels. Hugh Pinfold introduces the Navigator Freestyle bar — a compact 38–43 cm five-line bar with offset finger bar, handle-pass leash, and releasable freestyle leash ring.

structured_review.summary: The 2025 North Pulse is a purpose-built Modern-C freestyle kite engineered specifically for unhooked riding, delivering explosive pop and exceptional line slack for handle passes and technical tricks. Its five-strut construction, 3D arc shape, and fifth-line bridle system combine raw C-kite aggression with improved depower and safe relaunch capability. This is a dedicated tool for serious freestyle riders — not a crossover kite.
pros: Exceptional line slack for extended hang time during handle passes and unhooked tricks
Explosive pop and powerful, fast turning response
Five-strut design keeps the canopy stable and profile consistent
Improved depower over traditional C-kites via fifth-line single bridle
Adjustable bar pressure at the rear wing tips
High-quality SK99 Dyneema lines and robust two-ply trailing edge reinforcement
cons: Requires a dedicated five-line control bar — not compatible with standard four-line setups out of the box
High bar pressure may not suit riders who prefer lighter, more effortless handling
Freestyle leash only partially depowers the kite on a missed pass — not a full flag-out unless safety is pulled
Smallest bar size (38–43 cm) is standard, limiting turning speed options without accessory purchase
Not designed for versatility — riders wanting a freeride or wave option need a different kite
structured_review.best_for: Dedicated freestyle and wakestyle riders focused on handle passes, board-offs, and progressive unhooked technical tricks.
structured_review.not_for: Beginners, freeriders, or anyone wanting a versatile all-around kite they can use for multiple disciplines.
structured_review.rec_blurb: Maximum line slack and explosive pop — built for riders who live unhooked.
